Overview

Beaverton is a city in OR with a population of 98,000. Nike’s global headquarters with a diverse community and MAX light rail access. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 8b growing zone supports Warm — citrus, avocados, tomatoes, peppers. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Sunshine is limited, with about 145 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
